title: Scheduler & file discovery to SQS
summary: Our own EventBridge-Scheduler-like cron service, with a first job that discovers new raw files and queues them.
goal: A scheduler service runs cron jobs exactly once even with two instances, and new raw files become ledger rows and queue messages within about a minute.
success_criteria: Jobs fire on their cron schedule and every run is recorded.
Two scheduler instances never run the same job at the same time.
Every raw file is discovered exactly once, including late arrivals.
Discovered files are queued in batches of 10.
rust_learning_outcomes: sqlx with compile-time checked queries and migrations
Postgres advisory locks and RAII guards
out_of_scope: A distributed scheduler beyond Postgres locks
